Cardinal Powder Coating — Full Color Library

131 stock colors pulled directly from Cardinal's own color-chart page — real reference photos, not flat approximations. Search, filter by finish family, and click any color to see it up close before choosing. (Primer and Exterior-finish colors are excluded from this picker.)

Why the photos matter here: a lot of these finishes — hammertones, textures, metallics, veins — don't read correctly as a flat color swatch. This picker always shows Cardinal's actual reference photo, and clicking a color opens it larger so the texture and finish are actually visible, not just an approximate hue. Every photo is embedded directly in this file, so it always displays — no internet connection or live link to Cardinal's site required.

Data source: 131 of Cardinal's 136 stock colors — names, codes, and reference photos pulled directly from cardinalpaint.com/powder/color-chart/ on 2026-08-26 — not name-guessed or hand-transcribed. The 4 Primer-finish colors and 1 Exterior-finish color from the full catalog are excluded from this picker. The small dot next to each name is a real pixel-sampled average from that color's own photo, used only as a loading placeholder before the photo renders.

Note on this sample: every photo is embedded directly in this file (not linked live to Cardinal's site), so colors display reliably wherever this page is opened — in a browser, downloaded, or viewed in an inline preview. One color (Telephone Gray Texture, C241-GR85) is stored on Cardinal's site as a .tif file, which browsers can't read directly — its photo here was captured as a screenshot instead, so it displays like every other color. One color (Grey Hammer, C013-GR08) has a broken photo link on Cardinal's own site — shown here as a flat swatch in its verified color instead.
